name: Netley Creek Golf & RV Park
note: RV park at Netley Creek Golf Course in Petersfield, 25 minutes north of Winnipeg: about 115 full-hookup sites (water, hydro, sewer), most of them seasonal, with nightly, weekly and monthly stays on the rest; pool and splash pad, washrooms with showers, laundry, restaurant; open May 15 - Oct 15. --Claude  SEASONAL SHARE: 77 of the ~115 sites were built for seasonal campers; nightly stays share the other 38 ('limited spots'). --Claude  MINIMUM STAY: 2 nights on every stay (operator's rate page and Let's Camp, 2026-10-11). --Claude

field_notes.Booking: Nightly sites have a two-night minimum (operator's rate page); its Let's Camp page is 'open for bookings of 2 nights or more'. Added with the minimum marked (AWH's rule of 2026-10-10).
field_notes.Fees: Nightly C$51 plus tax; weekly C$300, monthly C$900.

name: Jaggars Point Oceanfront Campground Resort
note: Family campground on Jaggars Point at Smiths Cove near Digby, on the Annapolis Basin: about 38 nightly RV sites (15-amp water/electric, 30-amp water/electric and 30-amp full hookup) among ~80 seasonal lots, plus tent sites, cabins and a rental trailer; pool, mini golf, showers, laundry, WiFi, 2,500 ft of shore to walk. Book by request form or phone. --Claude  MINIMUM STAY: 2 nights on every stay (booking form, 2026-10-11). --Claude

field_notes.Booking: Bookings by online request form or phone; 'We have a minimum two night stay requirement' (booking form). Added with the minimum marked (AWH's rule of 2026-10-10).
field_notes.Fees: RV sites C$50-53 (15-amp water/electric), C$63 (30-amp water/electric), C$60-70 (30-amp full hookup) a night, taxes and fees included; tent sites C$41.

name: The Landing on Red Gut Bay
note: Fishing camp on Red Gut Bay of Rainy Lake, ~30 mi E of Fort Frances off Hwy 11. RV/trailer sites with water and electric plus a modern shower house and freezer service; reservation-only; campsites C$270 a week (2026, plus 13% HST). The rates page's '4 Day minimum charge' is the cabins'. --Claude

field_notes.Fees: 2026: C$50 a day per unit with water, electric, showers and freezer service, C$270 a week, plus 13% HST; docking and extra-vehicle parking C$12 a day.

name: West Glacier KOA Resort
note: Big KOA resort on Halfmoon Flats Rd, about 3 miles from Glacier's West Entrance; patio, full-hookup and water/electric RV sites, cabins and tent sites. --Claude

field_notes.Fees: KOA booking form, 1 night 2027-06-15 (Tue), 23-ft motorhome, before tax: back-in 50/30-amp water/electric $145; full-hookup standard, landscape and combination RV & tent sites $185; pull-thru Deluxe Patio $205; back-in Deluxe Patio $269.

name: Cape Hatteras / Outer Banks KOA Resort
note: KOA Resort at 25099 NC Hwy 12, Rodanthe, between the Atlantic and Pamlico Sound with direct beach access; some RV sites sit on the dune or a short walk from the beach. Hatteras Island is reached only by NC 12 across Pea Island, which ocean overwash closes in storms: closed with visitors evacuated in September and again from October 16, 2026 (Dare County). --Claude

field_notes.Booking: KOA's booking form, 2027: 'Stay requires a 2 Night Minimum if arriving on Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday or Sunday for stays between 04/01/2027 and 10/31/2027.' No minimum shown for January or March nights. Monthly stays by phone.
field_notes.Fees: Strongly seasonal. KOA's booking form, one night, RV, 2 adults, a 23-ft motorhome, site rate before tax: Tue 2027-01-12 and 2027-03-09 $35 (Back In 30/20-amp water/electric, near bathhouse) to $95 (dune full-hookup with shade shelter); Tue 2027-05-18 $70 to $130 (5 of 11 types available); Tue 2027-07-13 $150 (back-in water/electric) to $260 (KOA Patio full hookup). Monthly RV stays from $895/month by phone.
field_notes.Sites: KOA lists a 90-ft max length. 11 RV site types, back-in and pull-through, water/electric or full hookups; some with shade shelters, KOA Patios, a Paw Pen, on the dune or a short walk to the beach.

name: Bellefonte / State College KOA Holiday
note: KOA Holiday at 2481 Jacksonville Road, Bellefonte; full-hookup and water/electric RV sites, pull-throughs. --Claude

field_notes.Booking: Book on koa.com or by phone 1-814-355-7912; deposit by credit card. Seven days' notice to cancel RV sites (two weeks over Penn State home football and Parent's Weekend, four weeks over Graduation); $20 processing fee.
field_notes.Sites: Pull-through full-hookup sites (including XL pull-throughs built in 2019, 'far longer than our standard pull-thru sites') and back-in 30-amp water/electric sites 'for smaller units'; gravel pads. KOA lists '120' Max Length'.

name: Charlottesville KOA Holiday
note: KOA Holiday at 3825 Red Hill RD, Charlottesville; full-hookup and water/electric RV sites, pull-throughs. --Claude

field_notes.Season: Pool open 5/22-9/7 (Memorial Day weekend to Labor Day weekend).
field_notes.Fees: KOA booking form, one night from Tue 2027-05-18 for a 23-ft motorhome, before tax: pull-through 30/20-amp water/electric $67, back-in 50/30/20-amp full hookup $72, pull-through 50-amp full hookup $77, pull-through full hookup with KOA Patio $98. 'KOA Select My Site' is extra. Read 2026-10-21 (same as 2026-10-19).
field_notes.Sites: Pull-through sites to 65 ft ('Max pull thru: 65 feet'), back-in full-hookup sites, patio sites; wooded gravel sites. Also tent sites and cabins.

name: Harrisonburg / Shenandoah Valley KOA Holiday
note: KOA Holiday at 12480 Mountain Valley Road, Broadway; full-hookup and water/electric RV sites, pull-throughs. --Claude

field_notes.Season: Limited services in the off-season; pool Memorial Day weekend to Labor Day weekend.
field_notes.Fees: KOA's booking form, one night from 2027-05-18 (Tuesday), RV, 2 adults, a 23-ft motorhome: Back In 30/20-amp water/electric $65.99 (another $66.99); full hookups $71.99-79.99; KOA Patio full-hookup sites $120.99. Site rate before tax.
field_notes.Sites: KOA lists '75' Max Length' and 'Max pull thru: 90 feet'; pull-through and back-in sites, water/electric or full hookups, some with a KOA Patio.

name: Natural Bridge / Lexington KOA Holiday
note: KOA Holiday at 214 Killdeer Lane, Natural Bridge; full-hookup and water/electric RV sites, pull-throughs. --Claude

field_notes.Fees: KOA's booking form, one night from 2027-05-18 (Tuesday), RV, 2 adults, a 23-ft motorhome: Back In 30/20-amp water/electric $47; pull-through water/electric $53-60; full hookups $60-70; KOA Patio full-hookup sites $80-95. Site rate before tax.
field_notes.Sites: KOA lists '82' Max Length'; pull-through and back-in sites, water/electric or full hookups, some with a KOA Patio.

name: Richmond North / Kings Dominion KOA Holiday
note: KOA Holiday at 10061 Kings Dominion Blvd, Doswell; full-hookup and water/electric RV sites, pull-throughs. --Claude

field_notes.Booking: Online through koa.com or 1-804-876-3500. Max stay 27 nights; two vehicles per site. 'KOA Select My Site' is +$20.
field_notes.Fees: KOA's booking form for RV, 2 adults, a 23-ft motorhome, one night, before tax: Tue 2026-11-03 water/electric $35, full hookup $42-86 (Patio site $86); Sat 2026-11-07 water/electric $71, full hookup $79-150; a mid-May 2027 weeknight (read 2026-10-19) $50-115. Prices move with date and demand.

name: Virginia's Beach Lakefront Cabins & Camping
note: Mostly seasonal: about 26 of its ~115 RV sites are sold by the night (a lakefront row, a lake-view row and wooded water/electric sites), alongside lakefront cottages and cabins. Reservations by phone with a credit-card deposit or an email request form, no online booking; 21+ to reserve. --Claude

field_notes.Booking: Three-night minimum on holiday weekends. Reservations from Feb 1 by phone (100% deposit) or email request form; walk-ins taken if a site is free.

name: Sugarloaf Key RV Resort & Cottages
note: Formerly Lazy Lakes RV Resort, then Sun Outdoors Sugarloaf Key until it went independent in April 2025. RV sites line a 7-acre saltwater lake. Winter (Dec 1 - Mar 31 check-ins) takes 7 nights minimum; single nights sell the rest of the year. --Claude

field_notes.Booking: Campspot refuses fewer than 7 nights on every RV type a 23-ft motorhome fits for check-ins from December 1 through March 31; single nights sell on November 30 and April 1. Monthly peak-season sites (Dec 1 - Mar 31) are booked by phone, 443-664-3375.

name: Boyd's Key West Campground
note: A family-run campground since 1963 with about 200 RV and 50 tent sites on Stock Island, 5 miles from Duval Street. US callers book by phone and international guests by a request form; there is no online booking. Weekly stays may be required on some site types from Oct 15 to Apr 30. --Claude

field_notes.Booking: A 4-night minimum applies over Fantasy Fest, Christmas and New Year's. From Oct 15 to Apr 30 'weekly stays may be required for certain site types' (FAQ), with no list of which types. Daily rates are posted for every RV type in every season.

name: Lake Minatare State Recreation Area - Butte View Campground
note: Lake Minatare SRA's Butte View campground, 3 km east of Lake View across the lake, in the woods off the east-side park road: paved back-in electric plus sites, part bookable online, the rest first come. A wildlife refuge, closed to all public access October 15 - January 15. Park entry permit required. --Claude

field_notes.Season: Closed to all public access October 15 - January 15 (wildlife refuge).
field_notes.Fees: In season: primitive $10, basic $15, electric plus $30 a night (ReserveAmerica, June 2027); $5 less in the off-season except primitive. The park is closed October 15 - January 15. Plus tax.
field_notes.Sites: 49 electric plus sites (50 A, paved back-ins); ReserveAmerica books 36 and posts no lengths.

name: Lake Ogallala State Recreation Area - West Campground
note: Lake Ogallala SRA's West Campground, on the west shore of Lake Ogallala just below Kingsley Dam, with its own West Entrance off the Keystone road; across the lake from the East Campground. Basic grass sites off dirt and gravel lanes, spread about 2.3 km along the shore: a peninsula loop, a shore strip and a south loop; several RV sites sit right on the bank. No hookups; water at the fish-cleaning station, playground and south boat ramp. Pad lengths are not posted anywhere (2026-11-05); RVs are seen on the loops on imagery. Advance reservation only, like all Lake McConaughy/Ogallala camping. Park entry permit required. --Claude

field_notes.Booking: All camping at Lake McConaughy and Lake Ogallala is by advance reservation only.
field_notes.Fees: Basic $15 Sunday-Wednesday, $20 Thursday-Saturday (May 21 - September 12), $10 the rest of the year. Plus tax.
field_notes.Sites: 68 RV-or-tent basic grass sites (plus 32 tent-only), all drive-in; no lengths posted.

name: Calamus Reservoir SRA - Valley View Flat Campground
note: Small campground near the upper (northwest) end of Calamus Reservoir, on its own road off the highway: one paved loop of electric pads under mature trees, set back from the boat ramp and parking lots; tent sites and designated parking-lot spots alongside. Shower house here; the park's dump station is at Little York Point. Park entry permit required. --Claude

field_notes.Booking: Reservable May-September; first come (self-pay, cash or check) the rest of the year.
field_notes.Fees: Every RV site here is Electric Plus (50 amp): $30 a night in season, weekends included (ReserveAmerica, May and June 2027), $5 less mid-October through April (NGPC rates grid). Plus tax, the $8.50 reservation fee when booked online, and a park entry permit ($7 a day for a Nebraska vehicle, $14 otherwise; $35 / $70 a year).
field_notes.Sites: 10 Electric Plus back-in paved pads (33-42); ReserveAmerica books 9. The 13 hike-in tent sites and parking-lot spots are not counted.

name: Danny Elliott Park (Oswego)
note: City of Oswego river park on the north bank of the Neosho, across the Xavier Road bridge from town and below the bluff Kamp Siesta sits on, beside the low weir: four sites strung along a gravel spur beside an open picnic lawn. No restroom here and the city gives no pad length; the dump station and the pay drop box are at Kamp Siesta. --Claude

field_notes.Fees: $15 a night, pay at the drop box at Kamp Siesta or the City Office. Monthly $300 with prior approval.
